main_body: A snow-covered conifer (fir) with a tiered dark green canopy, snow clumps on branch tiers, and a short brown trunk at the bottom.
top_band: Organic conifer: the snow caps on each tier (white/pale blue, rows ~12-14, 23-26, 34-37, 45-49) sit as lighter bands on top of the green tier faces; the tree tip has a snow cap at rows 1-3.
evidence: The tree is an organic conifer silhouette. Each tier has a lighter snow band over darker green foliage, and the dark green under each snow band reads as shading below the snow overhang. There are no receding side faces. It reads as a conical tree viewed from above-front, with horizontal snow surfaces on the branch tiers. Being organic, it is not a flat elevation or a rim-only object. The snow bands are several rows thick on the lower tiers (4-5 rows), and the form is a volumetric cone. Pass.

style.evidence: Foliage has about 4-5 green steps (dark teal-black, deep green, mid green, lighter green highlights on the left) plus 3 snow tones (white, pale lavender, blue-grey shadow). Outline is a dark teal-green tinted to the foliage, not neutral black. Foliage has needle-clump variation and snow has drip edges and shaded undersides, so there are no large flat fills. It is a little less rich than the leafy Beodeul references, which have more varied clumps and highlights, but it is clearly crafted with the same selective-shading approach and would sit acceptably beside them.
